name: relay-agent-starter
description: Starter for a Relay agent on Cloudflare Agents: signed webhook in, durable reply out.

RELAY_AGENT_TOKEN.description: Agent Token from Relay Console. Create an agent, copy the rly_live_... token. Relay shows it once.

RELAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Signing secret returned by POST /v1/webhook-subscriptions when you register this Worker's URL. Relay never returns it again.
